messages:
Nina: Quick thread - two customers asked for a single-view that ties traces to cost. They want actionable recommendations (e.g., switch to q4 for route X). Can we scope an MVP?
Cam: Agree. MVP = heatmap (route x model) + tiny sampled spans + a "recommendation" column in CSV. Keep ingest budget low.
Jordan: UX: show est $/1k tokens and a delta if they switch model. Drilldown to sample traces only when spans exist.
Len: Emit a 1-line span: tags = model, route, token_count, quant_variant. Default sample 0.5%. Add org-level toggle.
Priya: CS: customers want CSV and S3 export. Enterprise requires PII masking by default and KMS gated raw exports.
Cam: Ops constraint: ingestion overhead must be <=5% in canary. Fallback to aggregated counters per minute if exceeded.
Jordan: Launch criteria draft: heatmap + CSV, sampling toggle, p95 latency regression <2% in canary, ingest delta <5%.
OpsBot: canary scheduled for cohort at 3890012350 :rocket:
Nina: OK next steps - Len + Cam to produce infra spec and cost estimate by EOD tomorrow. Priya will validate export + masking with customers. Follow-up in #product next Tue.
